## Digest dir namespaced as trie/triediffs (trie-owned namespace, no collision… — 2026-07-25 (parent 291c91be3c43)

The digest archive directory was renamed from `trie/triediffs` to `triefacts/triediffs`, relocating it inside the triefact tree. To prevent old digests from feeding back into new evidence, a new function `_triefact_pathspecs` was introduced in `trie/session_diff` that produces git pathspecs with an `:(exclude)<diffs_dir>` entry; `collect_session_diff` and `collect_symbol_deltas` now use these pathspecs when running raw diffs and enumerating tracked/untracked files. The pre-commit hook block in `trie/init:PRE_COMMIT_HOOK_BLOCK` was updated to `git add TRIE_DIFF.md triefacts/triediffs`. `trie/
